text:
گھڑے دا گھیو—کڑی دا پیو—
جٹکا شاہ—انہاں تریہاں دا نہیں وساہ۔
romanized:
Gharé dā ghéo—kuṛī dā pyo—
Jaṭkā shāh—innhā̃ tréhā̃ dā nahī̃ vasāh.
literal_en: There is no trusting to these three—clarified butter in an earthen vessel, to the father of a marriageable girl, or to a village money-lender.
meaning_en: i.e., as to whom he will give her to in marriage.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
